cart|sub:home/home: Where every visit starts: your latest decks, and how far along each one is.
cart|unit:home/home/help: The ?| opens help for the screen you’re on.
cart|unit:home/home/in-use: Cards in use| counts only committed decks. “Spoken for twice” means your decks want more copies of a card than you own.
cart|sub:home/whats-new: News you choose to hear about, newest first, such as a new set or a combo you can now make. Within Today and Earlier, anything waiting on you comes first.
cart|unit:home/whats-new/lead: The top story| is the one thing you haven’t seen yet that matters most. You choose what can lead in Settings: a new set, a combo you can now make, and more.
cart|sub:collection/cards: Everything you own, card by card, and which copies your decks are holding. Add cards by name or scan them in.
cart|unit:collection/cards/tabs: Cards, Sets and Proxies| are your Collection’s tabs. History lists your changes from the last 90 days. Wishlist holds the cards you’re after.
cart|unit:collection/cards/add: The +| adds cards by name. You can scan them in too.
cart|unit:collection/cards/key: The key| explains every mark a card can carry.
cart|unit:collection/cards/taken: In use| means committed decks hold every copy you own.
cart|unit:rule/one-copy: |A copy you own can live in only one committed deck at a time. The deck that’s held it longest keeps it, unless you hand it to another, and drafts wait behind committed decks. Own one Sol Ring and run it in three decks, and two of them show it short.
cart|unit:rule/never-decklist: |Changing your Collection never changes a decklist. A deck that loses its copy keeps the card, shows it short and puts it on its shopping list.
cart|sub:collection/upload: Bring in an export from another app or paste a list, and look over the import before you confirm it.
cart|unit:collection/upload/drop: Drop in a CSV| from ManaBox, Moxfield, Archidekt or Deckbox, or paste a list. Nothing changes until you confirm.
cart|unit:rule/replace: |With Replace, any card that isn’t in the file leaves your Collection, and changes you made in the app are overwritten. With Add, your quantities go up and nothing leaves. With Sync, the file’s changes come in, including cards it no longer has, and the changes you made in the app stay. If you both changed the same card, it asks you which to keep.
cart|sub:commanders/for-you: Commanders you own, ranked by how well the rest of your cards suit each one.
cart|unit:commanders/for-you/places: For you and Discover| are two ways to find your next commander.
cart|unit:commanders/for-you/fit: The fit score| says how well your cards suit a commander, out of 100, or out of 40 for one EDHREC has no decks for yet.
cart|unit:commanders/for-you/styles: Play styles| come from the decks EDHREC tracks for that commander.
cart|sub:commanders/discover: Commanders worth buying: ones EDHREC tracks that you don’t own and haven’t built a deck around. Search them, or narrow them by color or set.
cart|unit:commanders/discover/order: Order| sorts the list, and you pick it. Best fit ranks by how many of a commander’s popular cards you own. Something new ranks by how many of its themes your decks don’t play yet, and shows only commanders whose EDHREC card list you own at least 30% of. Popularity counts the decks EDHREC tracks. Name goes A to Z, and Recently released puts the newest first.
cart|sub:decks/your-decks: Your decks, each with its status. Start one from a commander, or import a list you already play.
cart|unit:decks/your-decks/new-deck: New deck| starts from a commander. Import brings in a list you already play.
cart|unit:decks/your-decks/deck-status: A deck’s status| says what to do next. “To buy” is a full deck you can’t sleeve yet, and “Draft” is one you’ve never committed.
cart|unit:decks/your-decks/decks-stats: Stats| puts every deck side by side: when each was last played, and how it went.
cart|unit:decks/your-decks/precons: Precons| lists every Commander precon, with how many of its cards you already own. Start a deck from one just as it comes in the box.
cart|sub:decks/your-deck: The list itself. Each row says whether you own the card and whether you’ve changed it, and your changes wait here until you commit.
cart|unit:decks/your-deck/row: A row’s dot| shows whether you own the card: filled green is in your Collection, hollow and dashed is not, or is a proxy. A bright edge marks a row you changed since your last commit.
cart|unit:decks/your-deck/bracket-marks: The marks after a name| flag Game Changers (WotC’s list) plus mass land denial, extra turns and tutors, which are read from card text and can miss one. Exhibition and Core allow no Game Changers, so count them before the rule zero chat.
cart|unit:decks/your-deck/lock: Lock cards| protects the cards you pick. No tool will cut a locked card unless you say so.
cart|unit:decks/your-deck/mix: Recommended mix| counts ramp, draw, removal, wipes and lands against what decks like yours run. “consider →” shows cards that fill a gap.
cart|unit:decks/your-deck/commit: Your changes| wait here until you commit. “Commit as v2” saves them as the deck’s next version.
cart|unit:rule/autofill: |When The 99 fills a deck, it starts with a few format staples, then uses your Collection, buying only where you run short and picking the cards your commander’s decks play most.
cart|unit:rule/lock: |A locked card is safe from every tool: none will offer to cut it, and updating the deck from a list starts it kept. The lock ends when you commit a version without the card.
cart|unit:rule/targets: |Targets come from the closest decks EDHREC can measure: decks with your commander first, then decks in its colors. With nothing to measure, they start from standard figures. So a Kinnan deck asks for more ramp than most. Going over a target never counts against you, and a card’s role is read from its text, so one can be missed.
cart|sub:decks/analysis: This screen isn’t on for you.
cart|unit:rule/credits: |Anything written just for you uses a credit, and a run that comes back empty-handed gives it back.
cart|sub:decks/versions: Every commit, kept, with its date, card count and average mana value. Open one to see what it brought in and took out.
cart|unit:decks/versions/version: Each commit| saves a version with its date, card count and average mana value. Open one to see which of its new cards you own today.
cart|unit:decks/versions/precon-link: Built from a precon?| Link it, and the deck’s history starts from the box as v0.
cart|unit:rule/commit: |A card you add to a committed deck takes your copy only once you commit, so your other decks still count it free until then. “Put back” on Review changes brings back a cut before you do.
cart|sub:decks/games: What happened at the table, game by game. Matchups shows how the deck does against each commander, color and friend.
cart|unit:decks/games/log: Log a game| after you play. It takes about fifteen seconds.
cart|sub:decks/stats: The deck in charts. See its curve by card type, its mana colors against their sources, the jobs its cards do, what it’s worth and how its games went.
cart|unit:decks/stats/curve: The curve| counts the deck’s spells, commander included, by mana value. Press a card type to light it up.
cart|sub:decks/notes: Anything you want to remember about the deck, kept with it through every commit.
cart|unit:decks/notes/note: A note| stays with the deck through every commit. No tool reads your notes.
cart|sub:shopping/deck-shopping: What one deck still needs, basic lands aside, priced at Mana Pool, with one link that fills your Mana Pool cart. Cheaper stand-ins are a press away.
cart|unit:shopping/deck-shopping/total: The total| is what this deck still needs at Mana Pool. “Buy these at Mana Pool” opens a cart with them.
cart|unit:shopping/deck-shopping/limit: “Marking cards over”| shows this deck’s price limit. Press the figure to change it.
cart|unit:shopping/deck-shopping/standin: ⇄| opens cheaper stand-ins for a card over your limit.
cart|unit:shopping/deck-shopping/buy: buy| shows the price. Press it when you’ve bought the card, and it goes into your Collection.
cart|unit:rule/own-it: |A card you own can still be on Shopping. If your Ghalta deck already holds your only Sol Ring, your Sai deck needs another.
cart|unit:rule/prices: |Prices are Mana Pool’s, and they refresh daily. A bare “buy” means Mana Pool has no price for any printing of that card.
cart|unit:rule/proxy: |A proxy comes off the shopping list and uses no copy. A token you mark “I have one” leaves every deck’s list, since any printing counts.
cart|sub:shopping/all-decks: Every deck’s missing cards in one cart, basic lands aside. A big cart goes to Mana Pool in parts. Open it from the top of Decks.
cart|unit:shopping/all-decks/total: The total| is the selected decks’ missing cards at single-copy prices. “Buy these at Mana Pool” sends them there.
cart|unit:shopping/all-decks/decks: Decks| picks which decks the cart shops for. Brews count.
cart|unit:shopping/all-decks/views: By card, By deck, By friend| read the same cart three ways.
cart|unit:shopping/all-decks/buy: buy| shows the price. Press it when you’ve bought the card, and it goes into your Collection.
cart|sub:friends/friends: The people you play with, and your pods. See their spares, and pick which pods see yours.

on|sub:decks/analysis: Which bracket your deck sits in, and why. Suggested changes, Proposed cuts and Mana Balance help you tune it.
on|unit:decks/analysis/bracket: Analyze| reads your list against the Commander Format Panel’s bracket rules and shows where your cards sit.
on|unit:decks/analysis/findings: What is in this deck| counts Game Changers, mass land denial, extra turns, two-card infinites and tutors. Each count opens to show its cards, and a card whose text hides what it does can be missed.
on|unit:decks/analysis/suggested: Suggested changes| asks how many cards to change and what you’re after, then offers more of each than you asked for. You pick, and apply them as one change. Each run uses a credit, or two for more than 10 changes. With Only cards I own on, Include my other decks also offers cards your other decks hold, and Apply asks whether to pull each one.
on|unit:decks/analysis/cuts: Proposed cuts| counts where a deck over 100 runs long, for free. “Look deeper” names the cards for a credit.
on|unit:decks/analysis/describe: Describe your deck| in a sentence or two. Suggested changes uses it to understand what the deck is for.
on|unit:decks/analysis/mana: Mana Balance| counts every source of each color against what your spells ask for. It’s free to run.
on|unit:rule/pick: |Suggested changes keeps the deck at 99. Ask for two and you get three to add and three to cut; pick two of each. The counts have to match before Apply, and one Undo takes the whole set back.
on|unit:rule/intent: |At either end of the scale, brackets come down to intent, so your cards can fit two. A theme deck with no Game Changers, mass land denial, extra turns or two-card infinites passes at both Exhibition and Core. Only you know which, so you pick. Game Changers are Wizards’ own list.
on|unit:rule/credits: |Reading a bracket is free. Anything written just for you uses a credit, and a run that comes back empty-handed gives it back. An Overview uses one. So does each Suggested changes run, or two for more than 10 changes. So does each Look deeper. A Suggested changes run that comes back short gives its credit back too, unless your limits, like a price cap, held it short. Pack and gift credits never expire. Plan credits end with the period after you cancel.
